# The `open_start_run` tool and the agent requests queue (server)

## What to build

The first agent tool. An agent in a graph-manager terminal calls `open_start_run` (through the `graph-manager-mcp` MCP server) when it has written a task folder; graph-manager queues a UI request that the browser picks up to open the **Start run** popup prefilled. This slice is server-only:

1. `src/server/agent-requests.ts`: an in-memory `AgentRequests` queue.
2. Cookie-authenticated routes `GET /api/agent-requests` and `POST /api/agent-requests/:id/ack` (`src/server/routes/agent-requests.ts`).
3. The tool `src/server/tools/open-start-run.ts`, registered in `TOOLS`.

The registry already exists in the codebase: `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/types.ts` exports `GmTool`, `ToolContext` (`{ ctx: AppContext; terminal: TerminalInfo; workspace?: Workspace; cwd: string }`), `ToolResult` (`{ text; isError? }`) and `defineTool`; `src/server/tools/index.ts` exports `TOOLS` (an array) and `toolList()`; `AppContext.tools` holds the tools and `BuildAppOptions.tools` replaces them in tests; `POST /api/internal/tools/:name` (in `src/server/routes/internal.ts`, Bearer `internalToken`) runs a tool with `{ terminalId, cwd, input }`. Read those files first. The spec is `docs/prd/agent-tools.md` (sections "Agent requests" and "The `open_start_run` tool").

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `docs/prd/agent-tools.md` — the contract (exact texts below are copied from it).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/types.ts`, `tools/index.ts`, `routes/internal.ts` — the registry and how tools are called.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 33–57 `AppContext`/`BuildAppOptions`; ~86 `const ctx`; 128–141 route registration "one line per feature") — add `agentRequests` and register the route module.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (lines 15–46: `PROVIDERS`, the start body schema, `insideWorkspace(ws, rel)`) — reuse `PROVIDERS` and `insideWorkspace`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runoptions.ts` (lines 5–18) — `runOptionsSchema` / `RunOptionsBody` (includes `extraArgs`).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/internal-tools.test.ts` and `routes/terminals.test.ts` (lines 16–37) — test setup: app with `internalToken`, login cookie, a workspace dir with `.git`, `POST /api/terminals { workspaceId }` to get a terminal id.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/terminals.ts` `TerminalInfo` (lines 7–21) — `workspaceId`, and (if a sibling slice already added it) `agent`.

## Patterns to follow

**Queue** (`src/server/agent-requests.ts`):
```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { RunOptionsBody } from "./runoptions.js";

export const AGENT_REQUEST_TTL_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
export interface StartRunPrefill { tasksDir: string; spec: string; provider?: string; options?: RunOptionsBody }
export interface AgentRequest {
  id: string;
  kind: "start-run";
  terminalId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  /** The terminal's agent id when known (e.g. "claude"). */
  agent?: string;
  /** The terminal's title, for the toast. */
  terminalTitle?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  prefill: StartRunPrefill;
}
export class AgentRequests {
  constructor(private readonly now: () => number = Date.now) {}
  add(r: Omit<AgentRequest, "id" | "createdAt">): AgentRequest  // replaces a pending request of the same terminalId
  list(): AgentRequest[]                                          // drops entries older than TTL first; oldest first
  ack(id: string): boolean
}
```

**Routes** — mirror a small route module such as `src/server/routes/reviewers.ts` / `routes/terminals.ts` (`export async function xRoutes(app: FastifyInstance, ctx: AppContext)`). Everything under `/api/` except `/api/internal/*`, `/api/auth/*` and health already requires the session cookie (auth hook in `src/server/auth.ts`), so no extra auth code is needed; verify with a test that a request without cookie gets 401.
```ts
app.get("/api/agent-requests", async () => ({ requests: ctx.agentRequests.list() }));
app.post<{ Params: { id: string } }>("/api/agent-requests/:id/ack", async (req, reply) =>
  ctx.agentRequests.ack(req.params.id) ? reply.code(204).send() : reply.code(404).send({ error: "request not found" }));
```

**Tool** (`src/server/tools/open-start-run.ts`):
```ts
const input = z.object({
  tasksDir: z.string().min(1).describe("The task folder, relative to the workspace root or the current directory"),
  spec: z.string().min(1).describe("The spec (PRD) file, relative to the workspace root or the current directory"),
  provider: z.enum(["claude", "codex", "opencode", "qwen", "fake"]).optional().describe("Provider to preselect"),
  options: runOptionsSchema.optional().describe("Run options to preselect"),
});
export const openStartRun = defineTool({
  name: "open_start_run",
  description: "Open graph-manager's Start run form for the user, prefilled with a task folder and spec. Call it when a task folder is written, validated and committed, instead of starting the run yourself. The user reviews the options and starts the run.",
  input,
  async run(i, tc) { ... },
});
```
Run logic:
- no `tc.workspace` → `{ isError: true, text: "this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace" }`.
- Resolve each path: if absolute, use it; else try `path.resolve(tc.cwd, p)` and fall back to `path.resolve(tc.workspace.path, p)`; make it relative to the workspace root (`path.relative(ws.path, abs)`, with `/` separators) and check with `insideWorkspace(ws, rel)`. For `tasksDir` also require `statSync(full).isDirectory()`; for `spec` require `isFile()`.
- Errors: `tasks folder <tasksDir> is not a folder inside the workspace`, `spec <spec> is not a file inside the workspace` (both `isError: true`); no request is queued on error.
- Success: `ctx.agentRequests.add({ kind: "start-run", terminalId: tc.terminal.id, workspaceId: ws.id, agent: (tc.terminal as { agent?: string }).agent, terminalTitle: tc.terminal.title, prefill: { tasksDir: relTasks, spec: relSpec, ...(i.provider ? { provider: i.provider } : {}), ...(i.options ? { options: i.options } : {}) } })` and return `{ text: \`Opened the Start run form in graph-manager with tasks folder ${relTasks} and spec ${relSpec}. The user will review the options and start the run; do not start it yourself.\` }`.

GOTCHA: `PROVIDERS` in routes/runs.ts is `["claude","codex","opencode","qwen","fake"] as const`; you may use `z.enum(PROVIDERS)` directly. Importing from `../routes/runs.js` into a tool module is fine (no cycle with app.ts beyond types).

GOTCHA: `TerminalInfo.agent` may or may not exist yet (a parallel slice adds it). Read it defensively as shown so this slice compiles either way; if it already exists, use it directly.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/agent-requests.ts` + `agent-requests.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the class above. Tests: add/list/ack; a second add from the same terminal replaces the first (list length 1, new id); entries older than 24 h are dropped (inject `now`); ack of unknown id → false.

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `agentRequests: AgentRequests` on `AppContext` (created in `buildApp`), `await agentRequestRoutes(app, ctx);` in the feature route list.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/agent-requests.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the two routes.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/open-start-run.ts`; UPDATE `tools/index.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: the tool; append `openStartRun` to `TOOLS`.

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/open-start-run.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** (skip on win32 — terminals spawn PTYs): app with `internalToken`, login, workspace `ws/github/octo/hello` (git init, with `tasks/1.json` and `spec.md` files), terminal from `POST /api/terminals { workspaceId: "github~octo~hello" }`, and a second terminal at the workspaces root (`POST /api/terminals {}`):
  - `GET /api/internal/tools` lists `open_start_run` and its `inputSchema.required` contains `tasksDir` and `spec`.
  - call with `{ tasksDir: "tasks", spec: "spec.md" }` and `cwd` = workspace path → text starts with `Opened the Start run form`, `isError` falsy; `GET /api/agent-requests` (cookie) → one request `{ kind: "start-run", workspaceId: "github~octo~hello", terminalId, prefill: { tasksDir: "tasks", spec: "spec.md" } }`.
  - relative to a subfolder cwd (`cwd = <ws>/tasks`, `tasksDir: "."`, `spec: "../spec.md"`) → prefill `tasksDir: "tasks"`, `spec: "spec.md"`.
  - with `provider: "fake"` and `options: { concurrency: 2 }` → kept in the prefill.
  - missing spec → `isError: true`, text `spec nope.md is not a file inside the workspace`, and the queue is unchanged.
  - `tasksDir: "../../.."` (outside) → `isError: true`.
  - root terminal → `this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace`.
  - `POST /api/agent-requests/<id>/ack` → 204, then the list is empty; again → 404; `GET /api/agent-requests` without cookie → 401.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `open_start_run` is listed by `GET /api/internal/tools` with `required` containing `tasksDir` and `spec`.
- [ ] A successful call returns `Opened the Start run form in graph-manager with tasks folder <t> and spec <s>. …` and queues one `start-run` request with workspace-relative paths.
- [ ] Error cases return `isError: true` with the texts above and queue nothing.
- [ ] `GET /api/agent-requests` → `{ requests }`; ack → 204 / 404; both need the session cookie.
- [ ] Tests pass: `npm test -w graph-manager`.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run build -w graph-execution
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- src/server/agent-requests src/server/tools src/server/routes
```
